moderation_ai_enabled.description: AI for unsafe-report checks and photo screening. false: unsafe reports count toward the pool; photos aren't screened.

moderation_ai_model_name.description: First Gemini model for moderation (Agent Platform / Vertex AI API). Must match gemini-[a-z0-9.-].

moderation_ai_fallback_model_names.description: Moderation models tried in order when one is retired. JSON array, max 4.

moderation_ai_location.description: Agent Platform location for moderation calls, e.g. global or us-central1.

moderation_ai_timeout_ms.description: Total deadline for one moderation AI call, 5000-45000 ms (clamped). A timeout never removes a post.

unsafe_confidence_min.description: An unsafe report removes the post only at or above this AI confidence, 0.5-0.99.

report_removal_threshold.description: Distinct counting reports that remove a post, 2-10.

strike_window_days.description: Removals count toward a posting pause for this many days, 7-90.

ban_after_removals.description: Removals within the window that pause posting, 2-10.

ban_days.description: Length of a posting pause, 1-30 days.

photo_screening_enabled.description: Screen photos of every published post with Gemini before alerts. AI failure keeps the post.

photo_screening_confidence_min.description: A screened photo removes the post only at or above this confidence, 0.5-0.99.

block_admin_alert_threshold.description: Admins get one push once a poster is blocked by this many people, 1-50.

admin_uids.description: Firebase uids that get admin pushes (offensive reports, appeals, blocks, AI health). JSON array, max 10.

ai_health_check_enabled.description: Daily 8 AM check that the configured Gemini models still exist; pushes the admins if not.
